SourceString: A small linear test for first implementation
Welcome. I am happy that you accepted our invitation.
Sure thing. I was in the area anyways, so it wasn't any trouble.
Great to have an adventurer of your renown in our humble village
It was a long journey I had to take. But I am finally here.
Can I help you with anything before you talk to the Oracle?
I heard the Oracle is unpredictable and knows witchcraft. Am I in danger here?
Not really, my mind is kinda blank. Do you have a suggestion for a good topic?
I  am as prepared as one can be. Let's do this!
Let me tell you a secret. That is a rumor we spread ourself.
Well, if you have the chance...
Do you have any idea how stressful it is for her to get pestered for every misplaced oxen-cart key?
Now people only come if they really have problems.
What? Don't leave me hanging. Out with it.
She wants a favor from you. So she might be inclined to answer if you ask for the upcoming lottery numbers.
But you haven't heard that from me!
Thank you. And don't worry - mum's the word.
I hope it is okay if I get right down to business? Time is of the essence here.
The early bird speaks silver, as the wise ones say.
And the worm gets the cheese. So true.
Are you aware of why I invited you here?
Not really. Besides promising a sizeable reward the invitation was pretty vague.
Could it have something to do with the evil looking forest behind the village?
The task I ask of you is not without danger. We will reward you accordingly.
Indeed, mighty adventurer. You have keen eyes and a sharp mind.
The forest that lies beyond our village is cursed and we fear for our lives!
You know that the forest beyond our village is still cursed?
An evil Forest? We are indeed living in grim times.
A curse? That doesn't sound good.
Say no more! I will find the origin of the curse and make short work of it!
We will pray for your swift return.
Now that you mention it. Would it be any trouble to provide me with the lottery numbers for next week?
Is there anything else I can do for you, before you leave?
To be precise not the forest is evil, but its denizens. Still, the entire situation is is very inconvenient.
I am afraid so. Although of what exact nature is still hidden from me.
Hey! This is the first dialogue line in this test dialogue!
Hey! Ho! Let's go! Gabba, gabba, hey!
Like the Germans are fond of saying: "Muss".
What do you think of the weather?
I am melting! Not a fan of this humid heat.
I am freezing, where is the sun?
I am cool with all the rain - I like jumping into puddles.
